rules.accepted_credit_types: Cultural competency course approved by an accreditation agency approved by the Board
rules.audit_note: No proof sent with renewal; random audits by letter to the address of record. No extensions or exemptions.

topics.who: Course on LGBTQ patients, BIPOC health disparities and intersectionality (B&P §4231(a))

rules.notes: The only Board CE requirement for technicians (since Jan 1, 2024): 1 hour cultural competency every two-year renewal, completed before signing the renewal. CPhT holders follow PTCB/NHA rules separately.
